say:2:1430208101:1.text: His uncle is in poor health, and he's the next of kin.
say:2:1430208101:1.source_cn: 他的叔叔身体欠佳，而他则是血缘最近的亲人了。
say:2:1430208101:1.male: His uncle is in poor health, and he's the next of kin.
say:2:1430208101:1.female: His uncle is in poor health, and he's the next of kin.

say:3:1430208102:1.text: According to the will, he will inherit his uncle's title and property. I envy him...
say:3:1430208102:1.source_cn: 按照他叔叔的遗嘱，他之后会继承他叔叔的爵位和财产……真...
say:3:1430208102:1.male: According to the will, he will inherit his uncle's title and property. I envy him...
say:3:1430208102:1.female: According to the will, he will inherit his uncle's title and property. I envy him...

say:4:1430208103:1.text: No need for jealousy, my friend. After I'm made a noble, you can come over any time.
say:4:1430208103:1.source_cn: 不用羡慕，我的朋友。等我授勋后，我邀请你一起体验。
